component.name: iGame Control
component.summary: Lighting, overclocking and fans for Colorful iGame GeForce cards
Lampu, overclock dan kipas untuk kartu Colorful iGame GeForce

description.p: An unofficial Linux replacement for Colorful's iGame Center. It controls the RGB lighting of Colorful iGame GeForce graphics cards and the power limit, clock offsets, clock lock and fans of NVIDIA cards, with live monitoring.

ul.li: 32 lighting effects, including music effects modelled on LedFx and a Smart Sound mode that picks an effect for the style of music playing
Accepts LedFx streams over DDP, so LedFx can drive the card
Power limit, core and memory clock offsets, clock lock and an optional crash-safe apply at boot
Per-fan automatic, fixed or curve modes with fail-safe hand-back to the driver
Profiles, a tray icon and a command line tool
